title: Scam calls
blurb: Someone called pretending to be your bank, a company or an officer.

title: Money gone from my account
blurb: UPI, card, net banking or a wallet.

title: Fake investment or trading
blurb: An app or a group that promised returns.

title: Loan app trouble
blurb: Harassment, threats, or your contacts being called.

title: Fake police or CBI call
blurb: Being told you will be arrested unless you pay.

title: Blackmail or threats
blurb: Someone demanding money, or threatening to share something.

title: Job or marriage fraud
blurb: A fee you paid, or someone you met online.

title: Fake profile or photos of me
blurb: Someone pretending to be you, or posting about you.

title: Account or device hacked
blurb: You cannot get in, or someone else is inside.

title: Suspicious link, QR or website
blurb: You spotted something and want it checked.

title: Gaming
blurb: In-game items, currency, or a game account.

title: Files locked or data leaked
blurb: Ransomware, or your information appearing somewhere.
